name: Retinol Snake Venom Peptide Gold Mask | Anti-Aging Moisturizing Brightening Skincare Cream 100g
description:
Revitalize your skin with the Retinol Snake Venom Peptide Gold Mask, a premium 100g skincare treatment that hydrates, brightens, and reduces visible signs of aging. Enriched with retinol and peptide complexes, it helps smooth wrinkles, boost elasticity, and restore a youthful glow. Its nourishing formula balances excess oil while providing deep moisturization, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Perfect for achieving radiant, soft, and refreshed skin.

Key Features
Retinol and peptide formula reduces fine lines and wrinkles
Deeply hydrates and softens for smooth, supple skin
Brightens and evens out dull complexion
Balances excess oil for fresh, shine-free skin
Suitable for normal, oily, sensitive, and combination skin
Easy peel-off application for convenient skincare routine

Ingredients / Materials
Retinol, Snake Venom Peptide Complex, Hydrating Agents, Brightening Extracts, Gold Essence

How to Use
Cleanse and prep skin with toner or rose water
Apply an even layer of mask cream on face
Allow mask to form a film for 30 minutes
Peel off gently from edges and rinse with water
Follow with basic skincare for best results

Package Includes
1 × Retinol Snake Venom Peptide Gold Mask (100g)
